text: {"lessons":["I should not sell or hold a stock just because it is below my average cost; decisions should rest on its prospects and my investment plan.","Several trades in a short span can add risk without proving an edge, so I should size positions deliberately and keep diversification in mind.","My account’s small gains so far do not show that I am beating the market; I should judge my approach over time against a suitable benchmark and adjust based on evidence."]}
